title: Audit the final duplicate ProbeCase collection admission outside the shared Boolean contract

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

question: After GPU-180 centralized bounded ProbeCase collection admission for the surviving CPU and CUDA arms, does another live Tensor diagnostic still maintain a parallel copy of the same collection checks, and can the next implementation remove that copy without inventing another abstraction?

duplicated_rules: reject str/bytes and non-Sequence case collections
require every entry to be ProbeCase
remaining_duplicate.why_duplicate: These are the same collection-admission invariants now owned by validate_probe_cases; the profiler should not retain a weaker parallel copy merely because it is a diagnostic consumer.

not_collapsed: _validate_profile_repeats remains profiler-local because MAX_PROFILE_REPEATS is a profiler-specific cProfile repetition bound, not the shared ProbeCase warmup/repeat policy.
cpu_bitset_baseline._measure_repeated remains the timing-mechanics owner used by the CPU probe and typed-block profiler; this packet does not move timing mechanics into the semantic contract.

finding: One exact collection-admission duplicate remains in typed_block_validation_profile.run_probe. The correct Gardener move is to reuse validate_probe_cases there and leave profiler-specific repetition policy local. No new module, registry, runner abstraction, scheduler, backend, cache, store, graph authority, or Tensor semantic layer is justified.

plan: import validate_probe_cases from the existing boolean_probe_contract in package and direct-script import paths
replace the three local case-collection checks in run_probe with admitted_cases = validate_probe_cases(cases)
iterate admitted_cases in the report construction
add a focused regression proving the profiler resolves the same validate_probe_cases function object and rejects invalid collections through that owner
do not alter _validate_profile_repeats or measurement semantics
next_bounded_change.expected_effect: Delete one parallel admission implementation while preserving exactly one shared Boolean case-collection contract and a separate profiler-only repetition bound.
